description: Search quotes on all boards. Every word of the query must appear, in any order; case and diacritics do not matter. Returns the matching quotes, whole-phrase matches first, each with a url that plays it, and the boards whose name matches.

board.description: Search only this board. A board slug, as list_boards gives it.

lang.description: Only boards in this language: cs, sk or en.

limit.description: How many quotes to return, 10 by default.

query.description: Words from the quote, in its language (mostly Czech), or a board name.

name: search_quotes
title: Search quotes
